questions.stem: What would happen to living organisms if all plants that carry out photosynthesis disappeared?
choices: Animals would have more food
Oxygen levels would increase
Carbon dioxide levels would decrease
Carbon dioxide levels would increase
questions.solution: If all plants that carry out photosynthesis disappeared, carbon dioxide levels would increase. This is because plants absorb carbon dioxide during photosynthesis, and without them, the levels of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere would rise. The other options are incorrect because animals would have less food, oxygen levels would decrease, and carbon dioxide levels would not decrease.

ऑक्सीजन के स्तर बढ़ जाएँगे
कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड के स्तर कम हो जाएँगे
कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड के स्तर बढ़ जाएँगे
hi.solution: यदि सभी पौधे जो प्रकाश संश्लेषण करते हैं, लुप्त हो जाएँ तो कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड के स्तर बढ़ जाएँगे। इसका कारण यह है कि पौधे प्रकाश संश्लेषण के दौरान कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड को अवशोषित करते हैं, और इनके बिना, वातावरण में कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड के स्तर बढ़ जाएँगे। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि जानवरों के पास कम भोजन होगा, ऑक्सीजन के स्तर कम होंगे, और कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड के स्तर कम नहीं होंगे।

mr.solution: जर सर्व फुले घेऊन जीवन चालवणारे वनस्पती नाहीसे झाले तर कार्बन डायऑक्साइडचे पातळी वाढेल. हे कारण वनस्पती फोटोसिंथेसिस दरम्यान कार्बन डायऑक्साइड शोषून घेतात, आणि त्यांच्या अनुपस्थितीत, वातावरणातील कार्बन डायऑक्साइडचे पातळी वाढतील. इतर विकल्प अयोग्य आहेत कारण प्राणी अल्प खाद्य असतील, ऑक्सीजनचे पातळी कमी होईल, आणि कार्बन डायऑक्साइडचे पातळी कमी होणार नाहीत.

questions.stem: What happens to the food produced during photosynthesis?
choices: It is stored as starch
It is used to produce oxygen
It is released into the air
It is used to absorb water
questions.solution: During photosynthesis, the food produced is stored as starch for later use. The correct answer is It is stored as starch. Oxygen is a byproduct of the process, not a product of photosynthesis, and food is not released into the air or used to absorb water.

questions.stem: What does the word equation for respiration in plants show?
choices: It shows the process of photosynthesis in plants

questions.stem: Based on the experiment described in Table 10.3, what can be inferred about the role of carbon dioxide in the process of food preparation in plants?
choices: Carbon dioxide is not involved in food preparation
Carbon dioxide is essential for food preparation
Carbon dioxide is a by-product of food preparation
Carbon dioxide is only used in non-green parts of the plant
questions.solution: The experiment shows that when carbon dioxide is removed, no starch is produced, which indicates that carbon dioxide is essential for food preparation. If carbon dioxide were not involved, starch would still form, but it does not. The other options are incorrect because they do not align with the observed results of starch production.

questions.stem: If a plant is kept in a dark room for a long time, what would be the most likely outcome?
choices: It will produce more oxygen than in sunlight
It will not carry out photosynthesis and will use stored food for energy
It will absorb more carbon dioxide than in sunlight
It will grow faster than in sunlight
questions.solution: In the dark, plants cannot carry out photosynthesis and will instead rely on stored food for energy through respiration. The other options contradict the basic process of photosynthesis and respiration in plants.

questions.stem: In a science class, students observed that when a plant was covered with a transparent plastic bag, the inside of the bag became moist. What is the most likely explanation for this observation?
choices: The plant absorbed water from the air
The plant released water vapour through its leaves
The plastic bag prevented water from escaping
The plant performed photosynthesis rapidly
questions.solution: The plant released water vapour through its leaves, which condensed on the inside of the plastic bag, causing it to become moist. The plant does not absorb water from the air, and the plastic bag does not prevent water from escaping—it traps the water vapour. Photosynthesis does not produce enough water vapour to cause moisture inside the bag.

questions.stem: Which of the following best explains the role of chlorophyll in the process of photosynthesis?

questions.stem: A student conducted an experiment where a plant was kept in a sealed container with a small amount of water. After a few days, the student noticed that the plant had wilted, and no gas was collected in a test tube. What can be concluded from this experiment?
choices: Plants do not require water for photosynthesis
Plants do not need to exchange gases with the environment
Photosynthesis stopped due to lack of water and gas exchange
Plants can survive without sunlight or carbon dioxide
questions.solution: The plant wilted and no gas was collected, indicating that photosynthesis stopped due to the lack of water and gas exchange. Water is essential for photosynthesis, and without it, the process cannot occur. The other options are incorrect because plants do require water and gas exchange, and they need sunlight and carbon dioxide for photosynthesis.

hi.stem: एक छात्र ने एक प्रयोग किया जहां एक पौधे को एक बंद कंटेनर में रखा गया जिसमें कम मात्रा में पानी था। कुछ दिनों बाद, छात्र ने देखा कि पौधा झुक गया था, और एक परीक्षण नली में कोई गैस एकत्र नहीं हुई। इस प्रयोग से क्या निष्कर्ष निकाला जा सकता है?

mr.stem: एका विद्यार्थ्याने एका पौष्टिक विधी केला जेथे एका वनस्पतीला छिद्ररहित बरोबर एका छोट्या पाण्याच्या मात्रेसह ठेवले गेले. थोड्या दिवसांनंतर, विद्यार्थ्याने लक्षात आले की वनस्पती विकृत झाली होती आणि टेस्ट ट्यूबमध्ये कोणताही वायू एकत्र झाला नव्हता. या प्रयोगावरून काय निष्कर्ष काढता येईल?

वनस्पतींना सूर्यप्रकाश किंवा कार्बन डायऑक्साइड शिवाय जगू शकता
